fit_statistics.weighting: Poisson approximation, sigma = sqrt(observed counts), because pointwise uncertainties were not supplied

fraction_basis: Weight fractions normalized to the three modeled crystalline phases; no amorphous fraction was determined.

phases.name: Ca3WO6-type ordered perovskite-related phase
phases.structure_reliability: The phase and ordered-perovskite topology are supported, but the exact low-symmetry oxygen coordinates are not independently determined by this powder pattern.
phases.structure_source: COD 2310470 (Ca3UO6 parent, U mapped to W; oxygen cage chemically adapted)

uncertainty_note: Formal covariance e.s.d.'s are much smaller than model uncertainty. The estimated systematic uncertainties reflect defensible ADP, nuisance-profile, and structural-source branches and are correlated across phases.
